quote: Our Cassino battlefield tour, with Frank de Planta as our guide, was absolutely brilliant. He planned the whole trip exceedingly well, his information was well researched and informative, a true expert. Frank’s enthusiasm and knowledge of the battle brought the whole conflict to life, and he covered all aspects of the battles of Cassino over the time we were there. We would definitely recommend Frank’s tour of Cassino to anyone who wishes to experience a true battlefield tour.
name: Moira & Barry Pomeroy
